STUDIO MELUSINÉ

STUDIO MELUSINE is an initiative of Nicole Girdo - an architectural designer and spatial artist working at the intersection of architecture, scenography, and landscape. Her practice explores how temporary and permanent structures can create moments of presence, ritual, and connection between people, place, and the unseen rhythms of nature.

With an international background spanning Moscow, New York, Barcelona, Venice, and site-based work across North/Central America and Southeast Asia, she works through hands-on design-build processes, natural materials, and immersive installations. Her projects often unfold in forests, festivals, cultural spaces, and public landscapes, where architecture becomes an experience rather than an object.

The work is guided by curiosity, material sensitivity, and a belief that spaces can hold emotional memory. She is interested in slow, tactile construction, light and sound as spatial elements, and collaborative practices rooted in learning, care, and belonging.
